verdict.rationale: Meilisearch offers an official MCP server that lets users create indexes, add documents, configure settings, and perform searches via natural-language prompts in an AI client, which is strong first-party evidence of natural-language operability. However this is scoped to an external MCP integration rather than a native NL interface built into the core product, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific MCP workflow beyond vendor docs. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the MCP natural-language workflow, evidence of natural-language support outside the MCP integration (e.g., built-in NL query parsing in core API), and detail on reliability/limitations of the NL command interface.
